component.name: Noor Notes
component.summary: Private, encrypted notes with focused editing for Linux

description.p: Noor Notes is a native GTK4/libadwaita application for private, offline-first writing on Linux.

Create and organize encrypted local notes, write in Rich Text or source-oriented editor modes, search and tag your library, and recover notes safely from Trash. Private on-device spelling, English grammar, and learned predictions are available by default; optional online assistance remains off until explicitly configured and tested.

screenshot.caption: Create and format a private sticky note.
Control private local and optional online writing assistance.
Apply persistent rich text and colours.
Find and replace text inside a note.
Work comfortably in a narrow window.

description.p: Restores complete sidebar, toolbar, menu, and status icons when a confined desktop cannot provide the user's selected icon theme.
Adds a responsive integrated editor, reliable shared formatting controls, safe DOCX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, and plain-text exports, and clearer editor-mode switching.

First production release with encrypted local storage, focused Rich Text and source editors, private writing assistance, refined Light and dark appearances, adaptive library navigation, reliable autosave, and recovery workflows.

Feature release with a redesigned adaptive library, refined Light and dark appearances, Rich Text and source editor modes, private writing assistance, responsive controls, and expanded recovery and organization workflows.
Security update with SQLCipher local encryption, GNOME Keyring integration, safe database migration, hardened networking, and stricter import and desktop boundaries.
Initial store release with offline notes, rich text editing, Xpad import, Trash recovery, and optional encrypted synchronization.
